task: This is a synthetic newspaper-writing exercise using fictional reporting notes. Use only the supplied reporting notes. Write from the reporting snapshot as of September 8, 2026. Write a headline and a 450–650-word AP-style reported feature about the people arranging their days around the overnight production shift at Low Ember Bakery and the customers who depend on it.

facts.text: A July 28, 2026, production note records Low Ember Bakery's first delivery van leaving at 5:45 a.m. while the finishing crew was still packing the second route.
The bakery supplies breakfast rolls and sandwich bread to 18 cafes and three workplace canteens.
Five employees work the overnight production shift, which runs from 12:30 a.m. to 8:30 a.m. and includes eight paid hours under the bakery's roster.
The overnight hourly rate is $25, including a $3 premium above the corresponding $22 daytime base rate.
The bakery moved production earlier in February after several cafe customers requested deliveries before their own opening times.
Baker Ceri Dain now finishes in time to collect her child from an afternoon school activity but relies on her partner for morning arrangements.
Dain says she sleeps during part of the daytime; the record contains no measured health or sleep outcome for the crew.
Dain said, "Finishing early gives me one part of the family day and takes me out of another."
Crew members can request roster swaps, and the supervisor recorded four approved swaps in August 2026.
The four approvals do not show every request made or establish that all employees can obtain their preferred schedule.
The bakery makes approximately 3,000 rolls on a normal weekday, with orders placed by customers before noon the preceding day.
Changes after that cutoff can leave the bakery with surplus bread or an unfilled addition to an order.
Owner Oren Moss sells some surplus at a reduced price from a morning counter but has no guaranteed buyer for every extra tray.
Cafe owner Nessa Orlen says a late bread delivery can delay assembled lunch orders even when coffee service opens on time.
Orlen said, "The morning rush in my shop starts with work somebody else did while our shutters were down."
The supplied August 2026 delivery log covers 120 completed stops, three of which arrived after the promised window.
No comparable earlier-period log was supplied, so the record does not establish that the new shift improved delivery reliability.
The bakery employs a separate daytime cleaning and preparation crew rather than asking the overnight bakers to cover all daytime work.
Low Ember occupies a former restaurant kitchen, and one wall still carries an unused menu rail.
The owner has not published a profit comparison or a net energy-saving estimate for the earlier production schedule.

forbidden_additions: A proven health, reliability, profit or energy improvement from the shift
All workers have the same family arrangement or unrestricted access to preferred shifts
preserve: If quoted: Finishing early gives me one part of the family day and takes me out of another.
If quoted: The morning rush in my shop starts with work somebody else did while our shutters were down.
The overnight premium is included in, not added on top of, the $25 rate.
